notes.title: v117 available
notes.notes:
A new version (v117) is now available.
It adds tutorial hints to the game.

The tutorial hints will show only on new games, not existing.
So if you want to see the tutorial, you have to select 'RESTART' from the menu.

notes.title: v116 now available.
notes.notes:
So yesterday, `Imhotep, Pyramid Builder' launched on steam.
To those playing the game: thank you for your support.

I've noticed much confusion on game play, so that is why I just put out a new release: v116.

Changes:

* Now, the `transcribe hieroglyphs' option is enabled by default, causing less confusion for new players, hopefully.

* Now, WASD keys can be used to scroll the map, as can the cursor keys.

Thank you,

  Bram Stolk
  Author of `Imhotep, Pyramid Builder'

PS: If you still have trouble understanding the game: please see the GUIDE. There is a link in the game's menu to it.

PPS: I would like to offer my apologies to Mac gamers: yesterday, not all Mac files were active on the store. It should work now.
